decision.text: If by this date any of the three passes (my real trades beat the S&P 500 over the 90 days, the system paper trades beat it, or an engine passes its live verdict), trading continues at its current size. If none of the three passes, I stop trading: the trading side goes off, new money goes into a halal index fund (ZAD), and the bot stays only for the stops on what I hold.
decision.amended: 2026-10-22 (same day, owner added the continue clause)
